timeline.summary: During the Travails, Avacyn's church turned against Nephalians, dragging away the accused and executing them in the Elgaud Grounds.
timeline.quote: And Avacyn's church turned against the people of Nephalia, dragging away those who were accused of giving offense to the angels and executing them in the blood-soaked Elgaud Grounds.

citation.text: "Nephalia", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Failing as an apprentice Skaberen, Tibalt isolates himself and experiments on living creatures' limits of pain, eventually using people.
timeline.quote: eventually, he moved on to people

citation.text: "Tibalt", section "Ascension". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Devils gather at Tibalt's laboratory and teach him the nature of pain.
timeline.quote: they sought to assist him, offering Tibalt insights into his obsession, the very nature of pain

citation.text: "Tibalt", section "Ascension". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Caught by inquisitors, Tibalt fuses his essence with the devils; the trauma ignites his spark and he is flung across the Blind Eternities.
timeline.quote: The shock and trauma ignited Tibalt's spark

citation.text: "Tibalt", section "Ascension". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Runo, using glamers and fortune, removed Nephalia's woodlands while turning the humans into artisans of wood.
timeline.quote: Runo, progenitor of the Stromkirk line, was crafty in his removal of the woodlands.

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Nephalia and the Undead
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Nephalia and the Undead". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Stromkirk and merchants tolerate skaberen and ghoulcallers as long as their work stays rumor.
timeline.quote: so their arcane trinkets and dark services are tolerated as long as they remain only rumors at the local taverns.

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Nephalia and the Undead
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Nephalia and the Undead". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The Erdwal originated as defensive trenches and grew into a trade network and black market.
timeline.quote: originated as trenches created by Nephalians in each of the major cities of Havengul, Drunau, and Selhoff for resisting zombie and werewolf attacks.

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Nephalia and the Undead
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Nephalia and the Undead". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Nephalia is designed as a port province of trade, arcane science and villainy.
timeline.quote: This province was mainly blue aligned, so it was a series of port towns.

citation.text: "Phonemes: The Molecules of Flavor". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Dec 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Journal entry 735 traces the stones and tidal distortion to a large reef off the Nephalian coast.
timeline.quote: a large reef off the coast of Nephalia

citation.text: "The Drownyard Temple" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: On the Nephalian cliffs a vacant-eyed fisherwoman tells Jace that a 'she' has arrived with feathered ones from the sky.
timeline.quote: Brought her feathered ones from the sky, tide came up right on with them!

citation.text: "The Drownyard Temple" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace bridges minds with the fisherwoman and finds himself trapped in a featureless dome inside her mind.
timeline.quote: His form was somehow trapped in someone else's mind.

citation.text: "The Drownyard Temple" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: A blind spot at the dome's center swells into a huge Object, and illusory duplicates of Jace appear around him.
timeline.quote: The blind spot in his vision had swelled to become an Object far larger than Jace himself

citation.text: "The Drownyard Temple" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: The dome shatters, revealing a latticed wall of eyes; Jace awakens on the path while the fisherwoman flees.
timeline.quote: His eyes snapped open to find his hands clapped over his head, his body curled up on the ground.

citation.text: "The Drownyard Temple" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace, disoriented, tells Liliana about Markov Manor, the moonfolk journal and the stones pointing to a drownyard in Nephalia.
timeline.quote: A drownyard, on the coast.

citation.text: "Liliana's Indignation" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Grete tracks Gisa to the remains of an old manor in Nephalia.
timeline.quote: I have caught up with Gisa in Nephalia.

citation.text: "Games" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Grete observes ghouls calmly walking toward Gisa's whistled summons along the Nephalian coast.
timeline.quote: They simply walk toward their conductor.

citation.text: "Games" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Gisa meets Nahiri, who cuts down her summoned ghouls and then becomes her friend.
timeline.quote: the woman unsheathed a tremendous sword and severed each of my ghouls on the spot.

citation.text: "Games" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Odric orders Grete to withdraw because too many undead and a strange structure are on the coast.
timeline.quote: pull out NOW

citation.text: "Games" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Gisa raises an army of ghoul builders for Nahiri to construct a stone monument.
timeline.quote: My new friend asked for an army of builders, and I have raised her one!

citation.text: "Games" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Gisa rejects Geralf's help, boasts of her legacy with Nahiri and sends their dead mother to deliver her letter.
timeline.quote: I hope you don't mind I sent Mummy to deliver it to you.

citation.text: "Games" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Arlinn returns to Innistrad, visits graves and confesses in churches and to angels.
timeline.quote: she had visited the graves, Reeves's, Leighton's, all of them.

citation.text: "The Archmage of Goldnight" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace recognized the name Emrakul in a chorus of cultists at a drownyard temple.
timeline.quote: Jace recognized a single word: "Emrakul."

citation.text: Exultant Cultist (Eldritch Moon, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ludevic becomes the most prolific builder of monsters from animated dead tissue in Nephalia.
timeline.quote: From his remote laboratory in Nephalia, Ludevic has established himself as the most prolific practitioner of a terrifying tradition

citation.work: It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!
citation.text: "It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Katilda warns that the land is sending a warning across Stensia, Nephalia and Innistrad.
timeline.quote: The land is sending a warning.

citation.text: Evolving Wilds (Innistrad: Midnight Hunt, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: A haunted fog, the Nebelgast, shrouds Nephalia's coastal cities.
timeline.quote: A haunted fog known as the Nebelgast shrouds the cities along Nephalia's coast.

citation.text: Port Town (Crimson Vow Commander, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Cyril Rav misfires a geistbomb, killing many people including himself; as a geist he possesses living bodies to gather influence.
timeline.quote: had misfired a geistbomb - an explosive device fueled with dead souls - that killed a bunch of people, including himself

citation.text: "Eloise Wicker", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rav, in the form of Nellick, discovers Hauken's powers and offers him a partnership, which Hauken accepts; the duo disappears leaving bodies behind.
timeline.quote: He offered Hauken an unusual partnership, which Hauken accepted.

citation.text: "Eloise Wicker", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Annoyed by Hauken's betrayal, Eloise offers her services to Millicent to track the fugitives.
timeline.quote: Eloise offered her services to Millicent to track the fugitives

citation.text: "Eloise Wicker", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Stromkirk vampires choose to concentrate their power in Nephalia instead of joining Stensian vampire politics.
timeline.quote: Unwilling to take part in the political and social machinations of Stensian vampires, those of the Stromkirk line chose to concentrate their power in Nephalia instead.

citation.text: "Stromkirk". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Runo Stromkirk uses glamors and his fortune to turn the human populace of Nephalia into artisans, becoming a secret patron.
timeline.quote: Runo became a kind of secret Nephalian patron, supporting master craftsmen and commissioning buildings, towers, and ships

citation.text: "Stromkirk", section "The Stromkirk influence". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Stromkirk vampires who joined the Nephalian coastal cults are among the first on Innistrad to be transformed into Eldrazi spawn.
timeline.quote: were among the first of Innistrad's denizens to be transformed into Eldrazi spawn

citation.text: "Stromkirk", section "Eldritch Moon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
